title: 🍼 [NICU Care Alert] Time for Baby Baby's Scheduled Feed (45-54 mL)
message_sms: [NICU Alert] Time for Baby Baby's 10:34 AM Feed! Target: 45-54 mL fortified breast milk. Paced upright feed, burp frequently. 24/7 NICU Helpline: 040-49694969
message_html:
🍼 Scheduled Feeding Reminder

NICU HOMECARE AI • PRETERM CLINICAL COMPANION

⏰ Interval Target (10:34 AM)

Hello, it is time for Baby Baby's scheduled feeding.

Recommended Feed Volume Target: 45-54 mL fortified breast milk (24 kcal/oz).

Clinical Care Instructions (AAP / WHO Protocol):

  • Paced Bottle Feeding: Hold baby in a semi-upright position with the bottle horizontal to prevent swallowing air or gulping.
  • Mid-Feed Burping: Gently burp after every 15–20 mL to relieve trapped gastric air.
  • Satiety Cues: If baby pushes bottle away, slows sucking, or falls into calm sleep, do not force them to finish.
  • Safe Sleep Post-Feed: Keep baby upright for 15 minutes before placing Back to Sleep in an empty crib.
🚨 24/7 NICU Helpline: 040-49694969

title: 🦘 [NICU Care Alert] Kangaroo Mother Care (Skin-to-Skin) Session for Baby Baby
message_sms: [NICU Alert] Time for Baby Baby's Skin-to-Skin KMC Session! WHO recommends min 60 continuous minutes upright on bare chest. Keep room at 22-24°C. Helpline: 040-49694969
message_html:
🦘 Kangaroo Mother Care (KMC) Time

RAINBOW CHILDREN'S HOSPITAL • THERMAL CARE

Hello, it is time for Baby Baby's daily Kangaroo Mother Care session.

Target Duration: Minimum 60 continuous minutes (WHO Clinical Standard).

KMC Best Practice Checklist:

  • Place baby diapered and upright against your bare chest in the frog-leg position.
  • Turn baby's head gently to one side with airway completely open and clear.
  • Cover baby with a warm cotton wrap or blanket. Ensure nursery room is comfortably warm (22°C to 24°C).
  • Skin-to-skin stabilizes preterm heart rate, oxygenation, and accelerates neurodevelopment.
NICU HomeCare AI • Safe Thermal & Kangaroo Care Protocol
